opus.problem: 'After rallying tribes against Midian' is not in the cited verses (Judges 6:36-37). The rallying is told in Judges 6:34-35, so this part of the clue is not supported by its reference.

Clues 1 to 6 all come from five verses (Judges 6:36-40). Each names Gideon in the dew test, so almost any one of them gives the word away on its own and none is medium hard. Clues 1, 2 and 6 all draw on the same request in 6:37. Replace some Gideon clues with other BSB uses of fleece, such as the first of the fleece given to the priests in Deuteronomy 18:4.
